The only stored Larkspur fact is unrelated: its client's connection pool ignores `HTTP_PROXY`, so you have to set `Client{Proxy: ...}` explicitly. This repo (`go.mod`, `main.go`) doesn't mention HTTP/3 or QUIC either.
